## 👋 Welcome to Tile-Compile Discussions!

We’re using Discussions as a place to connect with other members of our community. We hope that you:
* Ask questions you're wondering about.
* Share ideas and your processed astrophotography results.
* Engage with other community members.
* Welcome others and are open-minded. Remember that this is a community we build together 💪.

To get started, comment below with an introduction of yourself and tell us about what you do with this community — whether you're processing data from smart telescopes (Dwarf, Seestar), conventional setups, or experimenting with the TBQR methodology.

---

### About Tile-Compile

Tile-Compile is a toolkit for **tile-based quality reconstruction (TBQR)** of astronomical image stacks (methodology v3.3). It replaces rigid "lucky imaging" frame selection with a robust spatio-temporal quality model, preserving full photometric depth while achieving superior resolution.

### Use Discussions For

| Category | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| 💬 **General** | Announcements, introductions, and community chat |
| ❓ **Q&A** | Installation help, configuration questions, troubleshooting |
| 🖼️ **Show and Tell** | Share your processed images, parameter profiles, and results |
| 💡 **Ideas** | Feature requests and methodology suggestions |
| 🛠️ **Help** | Specific dataset challenges (low frames, bright stars, Alt/Az rotation) |

- Check the [README](https://github.com/jeamy/tile_compile/blob/master/README.md) and [Configuration Reference](https://github.com/jeamy/tile_compile/blob/master/docs/configuration_reference_en.md)
